                                                                                
 Usage: agentarts init [OPTIONS]                                                
                                                                                
 Initialize a new AgentArts project.                                            
                                                                                
 Creates a complete project structure with:                                     
 - .agentarts_config.yaml: Configuration file for deployment                    
 - agent.py: Agent implementation based on selected template                    
 - Dockerfile: Docker build file for containerization                           
 - requirements.txt: Dependencies including SDK and framework packages          
                                                                                
 After initialization, you can directly deploy using 'agentarts deploy'.        
                                                                                
 Examples:                                                                      
     agentarts init                                                             
     agentarts init -n myagent                                                  
     agentarts init -n myagent -t langgraph                                     
     agentarts init -n myagent -t langchain -r cn-southwest-2                   
     agentarts init -n myagent --swr-org my-org --swr-repo my-repo              
                                                                                
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --name      -n      <str>                       Project name                 │
│ --template  -t      <basic|langgraph|langchain  Project template (basic,     │
│                     |google-adk>                langgraph, langchain,        │
│                                                 google-adk)                  │
│ --path      -p      <str>                       Project path [default: .]    │
│ --region    -r      <str>                       Huawei Cloud region          │
│ --swr-org           <str>                       SWR organization             │
│                                                 (auto-generated if not       │
│                                                 specified)                   │
│ --swr-repo          <str>                       SWR repository (default:     │
│                                                 {name})                      │
│ --help                                          Show this message and exit.  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
